file_impact.reason: New sibling module: the git-subprocess + fetch-locking cluster extracted from repo_snapshot.py along an existing call-graph seam (that file is 788/800 LOC), carrying the new throughput-keyed stall abort (http.lowSpeedLimit/lowSpeedTime) and the bounded in-process retry of a low-speed abort.

Source of the extraction: the fetch/lock/git plumbing moves out and the in-file call sites are re-pointed at the new module. No behaviour change here; the public surface re-exported by _snapshot/__init__.py is unchanged.

New RED-first tests: a real local listener that accepts and sends zero bytes must abort fast, a listener dribbling bytes continuously must NOT be aborted (the throughput-vs-wall-time discriminator), the emitted git argv carries the low-speed options, and only a low-speed failure is retried.
